caption:
Checking it off on paper

Checking it off on paper.

Writing a task by hand slows you just enough to remember it, and the tick on the page is a small finish line.

For whoever keeps the whole list in their head.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a table. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes stands on the left, and a paper checklist on a clipboard stands on the right with three empty lines. A speech bubble says my list. Then dishes, and a green tick appears on the first line. Then plants, and the second tick. Then mail, and the third tick. Then all done with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: me checking things off on paper. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
